purpose: Compact public-safe directory of Evercraft offers currently marked sell_now. Match user pain first. Discovery creates no obligation and checkout is not payment proof.

offers.name: AliEV EV Site Opportunity Intelligence
offers.problem: A property owner, fleet, charging developer, broker, installer or investor needs source-backed EV infrastructure opportunity intelligence for a specific address or market without confusing mapped charger inventory, modeled demand, tariff context, incentives or feasibility.
intent_terms: is this site good for EV charging
what EV chargers are near this property
EV charger competition around this address
should I install EV chargers at this property
find EV charging opportunities in this market
offers.pricing: $299 Preliminary Site Opportunity Report; $750 Full Site Opportunity Report; $250 Qualified Opportunity Pack pilot; $2,500/month Territory Opportunity Feed.
offers.confirmation: Agents may discover AliEV, run the free screen, inspect offers and prepare a paid handoff. The handoff creates only a human review URL. Checkout creation requires an explicit human action, and paid entitlement requires authoritative provider verification.

offers.name: Career Command Interview Practice + Interview Sprint
offers.problem: A candidate needs role-specific practice and candid evidence-based feedback before an interview.
intent_terms: help me prepare for this interview
mock interview me for this job
prepare me for a recruiter screen

offers.confirmation: Free/basic practice creates no payment obligation. The $19 Sprint requires explicit user confirmation before checkout. Covert live-interview answer feeding is not offered.

intent_terms: help me find funding for my business
which lenders or programs fit my business
help me prepare for SBA financing
find capital options for this project
turn my business info into a funding deck
what am I missing before I seek funding

offers.confirmation: Explicit buyer authorization for source access and payment is required.
